//: OpenCues compatibility manifest for OpenCode. The fork is git-SHA pinned (not npm). Pin lives in integrations/opencode/pin.json (structured JSON, sourced by setup.sh + rewritten by `opencues update opencode --to <version>`). Patches target specific files in the fork (app.tsx, prompt/index.tsx, footer.tsx) — anything that touches those files in upstream needs a re-test before adding here.
//compat-range-note: Array of independently-supported ranges, one per adapter band. Upstream skipped 1.5.x..1.13.x — those minors don't exist in sst/opencode and are intentionally absent from this list. The active install always corresponds to one entry: pin.json's version determines which band+range applies.
